thread:
anya: Client 'Borealis' wants a lightweight POC for customer-facing summarization. They asked for a short delivery plan: which model variants, rough costs, and security answers. Need by EOD tomorrow.

client_io: Use case is live chat summarization + intent tags. Target ~8-12 rps, typical session ~1.5k tokens. P95 latency target ~250ms. Data contains emails + order IDs; must support PII redaction. Prefer open-source models; will consider quantized variants for cost.

diego: Questions: hosted ok or must be VPC? Any compliance needs?

client_io: Hosted ok for POC. If successful, enterprise rollout may need VPC and SOC2. Also need KMS for key control.

rachel: KMS + SOC2 noted. I'll prepare a short security pack: SOC2 attestation, KMS integrations (AWS/GCP), logging and retention. Also include a note on redaction tooling.

kevin: For 250ms P95 at 10 rps with 1.5k tokens, we should run low-latency routes on fp16 13B with batch_size 2 and a quantized variant for async processing. KV cache will help for repeated chat turns. If they move to VPC, allow 2 weeks for network & KMS tests.

diego: Suggest two-variant approach: open-13b-fp16 for low-latency hosted route + open-13b-quant for cost/throughput (dedicated). Add fallback routing when fp16 pool is saturated.

julia: Legal: prepare KMS addendum + DPA clauses. I'll flag subprocessors and prepare a redlineable addendum.

anya: Can someone draft a 1-page ops playbook (owners + timeline) and a quick pricing triad (trial, monthly commit, annual commit)?

diego: I'll do the ops playbook + pricing sketch. Quick pilot config (informal):
```\nroutes:\n  - low_latency: open-13b-fp16, batch=2, max_seq=1536\n  - bulk: open-13b-quant-4bit, batch=24, kv_cache=true\nfallback: prefer_low_latency_then_quant\nestimate: "~$2.8/token-unit (fp16), $0.75/token-unit (quant)"\n```

anya: Action items for tomorrow EOD:
- diego: ops playbook + pricing tiers + pilot timeline
- rachel: security one-pager + questionnaire responses
- julia: KMS addendum draft
- kevin: infra note on latency tradeoffs + VPC checklist

atlas-bot: Playbook ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/1795000000 :white_check_mark:

client_io: Great, thanks. We can meet after you share the doc.

anya: I'll schedule a 30m review once uploaded. Thanks team!
